result.instructions: Tools for Instamojo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my payment requests are still pending?"; "Show the payments made against my latest payment request."; "Create a payment link for 1500 INR for 'Workshop seat' and give me the URL.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Instamojo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run instamojo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run instamojo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run instamojo_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. instamojo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: instamojo_list_payment_requests
tools.title: List payment requests
tools.description: List the payment requests (payment links) of the account with id, purpose, amount (INR), buyer, status (Pending, Sent, Failed, Completed), short and long URL and timestamps. Paged: use next_page. GET /payment-requests/.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: instamojo_get_payment_request
tools.title: Get payment request
tools.description: One payment request by id, with its status and the payments made against it (the payment ids go to instamojo_get_payment). GET /payment-requests/{id}/.

payment_request_id.description: Payment request id (a 32-character hex id from instamojo_list_payment_requests).

tools.name: instamojo_create_payment_request
tools.title: Create payment request
tools.description: WRITE: create a payment request (a payment link) and return its id and URLs (longurl, shorturl) to share with the buyer. Amount is in INR. The buyer is NOT emailed or texted unless send_email / send_sms is true (they then need email / phone). Nothing is charged; the buyer pays on the link. POST /payment-requests/.

amount.description: Amount in INR (Instamojo documents a minimum of 9 and a maximum of 200000 per request).

purpose.description: What the payment is for (shown to the buyer). Often used as your own order reference.

email.description: Email of the payer (required when send_email is true).

phone.description: Phone number of the payer (required when send_sms is true).

redirect_url.description: URL the buyer is redirected to after paying (Instamojo appends payment_request_id, payment_status and payment_id).

webhook.description: URL Instamojo POSTs the payment details to after a payment.

allow_repeated_payments.description: true = the link accepts several payments (Instamojo's default); false = one payment only.

send_email.description: true = Instamojo emails the link to the payer (needs email). Default false: nothing is sent.

send_sms.description: true = Instamojo texts the link to the payer (needs phone). Default false: nothing is sent.

tools.name: instamojo_disable_payment_request
tools.title: Disable payment request
tools.description: WRITE: disable a payment request so its link no longer accepts payments (instamojo_enable_payment_request undoes it). Existing payments are not touched. POST /payment-requests/{id}/disable/.

tools.name: instamojo_enable_payment_request
tools.title: Enable payment request
tools.description: WRITE: enable a previously disabled payment request so its link accepts payments again. POST /payment-requests/{id}/enable/.

tools.name: instamojo_get_payment
tools.title: Get payment
tools.description: One payment by its id (MOJO...): status (Credit = paid, Failed), amount, fees, buyer, instrument (card, UPI, netbanking, wallet), failure reason, payout and the payment request it belongs to. GET /payments/{id}/.

tools.name: instamojo_list_refunds
tools.title: List refunds
tools.description: List refunds with id (case id), payment id, status, reason type, refund and total amount (INR) and date. Paged: use next_page. GET /refunds/.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: instamojo_get_refund
tools.title: Get refund
tools.description: One refund by its id (the case id from instamojo_list_refunds, e.g. C5c0751272). GET /refunds/{id}/.

tools.name: instamojo_create_refund
tools.title: Create refund
tools.description: WRITE (moves money): refund a payment, in full or in part. Instamojo allows only ONE refund per payment, so a partial refund cannot be topped up later. Without confirm: true nothing is sent and the call returns a preview of the refund; ask the user to confirm, then call again with confirm: true. Reason types: RFD = duplicate/delayed payment, TNR = product/service no longer available, QFL = customer not satisfied, QNR = product lost/damaged, EWN = digital download issue, TAN = event was canceled/changed, PTH = problem not described above. POST /refunds/.

payment_id.description: Payment id (MOJO...) of the payment to refund.

type.description: Reason code. RFD = duplicate/delayed payment, TNR = product/service no longer available, QFL = customer not satisfied, QNR = product lost/damaged, EWN = digital download issue, TAN = event was canceled/changed, PTH = problem not described above.

refund_amount.description: Amount to refund in INR; default the full paid amount.

transaction_id.description: Your own unique id for this refund case; Instamojo uses it to refuse a replayed call (mandatory from the second refund case onwards).

confirm.description: Must be true to actually create the refund; otherwise only a preview is returned.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Instamojo
prompts.description: What you can do with Instamojo here, with example requests to try.
